How teams form

Parents can register 1–4 students in one submission. Four students registered together automatically form a competition team. If you register fewer than four students, the organizer will help form a team.

Detailed round rules and the schedule will be announced here.

HOW TO JOIN

Three simple steps.

  1. 1

    Register your students

    Fill out the registration form for up to four students with one shared contact. Four students form a team automatically; the organizer helps smaller groups form a team.

  2. 2

    Check your email

    You will receive a copy of your registration answers by email.

  3. 3

    Continue to the school

    Make payment on the school's donation page and keep its receipt.

Registration questions? →

Register in three steps.

Registration is not open yet. The registration form link will be posted here.

Open the registration form ↗Continue to school donation page ↗
  1. 1

    Fill out the registration form

    Enter each student's name, grade, and school, plus one parent or guardian contact. You can register up to four students in one form. Four students registered together form a team; the organizer helps smaller groups form a team.

  2. 2

    Check your email

    Google Forms emails a copy of your answers to the address you enter. Keep it for your records. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.

  3. 3

    Pay on the school's donation page

    Payment amount: $25 per person · $100 for a group of 4

Submitting the form registers your students. Payment is confirmed separately by the organizer using the school's records, so keep the school's receipt.
